alphabetMatching.title: Alphabet Matching
alphabetMatching.description: Listen to spoken letters & numbers and tap the matching tile!

capitalSmallMatch.title: Capital & Small Letter Match
capitalSmallMatch.description: Match uppercase capital letters to their lowercase small letter pairs!

vowelMatraMatch.title: Vowel & Matra Match
vowelMatraMatch.description: Match independent vowels to their consonant matra forms!

alphabetMatching.modeSelectionSubtitle: Choose how you want to play!
alphabetMatching.modeAlphabeticalDesc: Match letters from A to Z in order!
alphabetMatching.modeJumbledDesc: Match shuffled letters for a fun challenge!
alphabetMatching.mascotGreeting: Hi! Pick a game mode to start playing!
alphabetMatching.learnAndMatch: Learn and match letters & numbers in a fun way!
alphabetMatching.step1: Listen to the letter or number sound played aloud.
alphabetMatching.step2: Tap the matching card from the options below.
alphabetMatching.step3: Complete rounds to earn stars and build your streak!

capitalSmallMatch.tapCapitalPrompt: Tap a capital letter to start matching
capitalSmallMatch.tapLowercasePrompt: Now tap the small letter for "{{letter}}"
capitalSmallMatch.tutorialStep1Body: Tap any uppercase capital letter in the left column to select it!
capitalSmallMatch.tutorialStep2Title: Step 2: Find its Small Letter Pair
capitalSmallMatch.tutorialStep2Body: Now tap its matching lowercase small letter in the right column!
capitalSmallMatch.tutorialStep3Body: Match all 4 pairs to finish the round and earn 3 stars! 🌟

vowelMatraMatch.step1: Tap a vowel on the left column (e.g. आ)
vowelMatraMatch.step2: Tap its matching matra form on the right column (e.g. का)
vowelMatraMatch.step3: Match all 11 pairs across 3 fun rounds!
